sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: MTP GGUF weights now available - alextech.ai
sources.snippet: The local AI ecosystem takes another leap forward with the release of GGUF versions for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next featuring Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) support. Published by Unsloth on Hugging Face, these weights enable the advanced predictive capabilities of Alibaba's model to run on consumer hardware via GGUF-compatible frameworks like llama.cpp.
